#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic read-only SQL audits for the EDARSAHUB universal worker.

No request-supplied SQL is accepted. Every profile is implemented as fixed SELECT
queries and executes through core.sql_first.db.readonly_sql_connection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
if str(BACKEND) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))

from core.sql_first.db import readonly_sql_connection

PROFILE = "gate1_connections_internationalization"
TARGET_OBJECTS = [
    "Sistema_Capacidades", "Sistema_TiposVariantes", "Sistema_Sync_Catalogo",
    "Sistema_VersionesSistemas", "Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion",
    "Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion", "Servidores_Conexiones",
    "Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad",
]
KEYWORDS = [
    "empresa", "unidad", "timezone", "zona", "pais", "moneda",
    "divisa", "cambio", "idioma", "locale", "preferencia",
    "credencial", "secreto", "homolog", "layout", "evidencia",
    "ejecucion", "externo", "software", "version", "sync",
    "capacidad",
]

def rows(cur):
    cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
    return [dict(zip(cols, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]

def execute(cur, sql, params=()):
    normalized = " \

def run_gate1():
    exact_placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in TARGET_OBJECTS)
    kw_where = " OR ".join("LOWER(t.name) LIKE ?" for _ in KEYWORDS)
    kw_params = tuple(f"%{k}%" for k in KEYWORDS)
    out = {
        "schema": "edarsahub.sql-readonly-audit.v1",
        "profile": PROFILE,
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "read_only": True,
        "ddl": False,
        "dml": False,
    }
    with readonly_sql_connection() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        out["database_identity"] = execute(cur, "SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user")
        out["target_objects"] = execute(cur, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS object_name, t.object_id, t.create_date, t.modify_date FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name IN ({exact_placeholders}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name", tuple(TARGET_OBJECTS))
        out["related_objects"] = execute(cur, f"SELECT TOP 500 s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS object_name, t.object_id FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE {kw_where} ORDER BY s.name,t.name", kw_params)
        object_ids = [r["object_id"] for r in out["target_objects"]] + [r["object_id"] for r in out["related_objects"]]
        object_ids = sorted(set(object_ids))
        if object_ids:
            ids = ",".join("?" for _ in object_ids)
            params = tuple(object_ids)
            out["columns"] = execute(cur, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE t.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id", params)
            out["indexes"] = execute(cur, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id", params)
            out["foreign_keys"] = execute(cur, f"SELECT sch1.name AS schema_name,t1.name AS table_name,fk.name AS fk_name,c1.name AS column_name,sch2.name AS referenced_schema,t2.name AS referenced_table,c2.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables t1 ON t1.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch1 ON sch1.schema_id=t1.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c1 ON c1.object_id=t1.object_id AND c1.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables t2 ON t2.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch2 ON sch2.schema_id=t2.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c2 ON c2.object_id=t2.object_id AND c2.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE t1.object_id IN ({ids}) OR t2.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY sch1.name,t1.name,fk.name", params + params)
        else:
            out["columns"] = []
            out["indexes"] = []
            out["foreign_keys"] = []
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, default=str, separators=(",", ":")))

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.profile != PROFILE:
        raise SystemExit("UNSUPPORTED_READ_ONLY_AUDIT_PROFILE")
    run_gate1()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def base_job():
    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-job.v2",
        "job_id": "readonly-gate-test",
        "target_repo": "rbalam/EDARSA_HUB",
        "target_branch": "Edarsahub_Desarrollo",
        "production_allowed": False,
        "objective": "test",
        "human_summary_language": "es",
        "mode": "READ_ONLY",
        "actions": [],
        "checks": [{"type": "sql_readonly_audit", "profile": "gate1_connections_internationalization"}],
    }

def test_bridge_accepts_only_fixed_readonly_profile():
    bridge = load("worker_bridge_readonly_test", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    assert bridge.validate(base_job()) == []
    job = base_job()
    job["checks"][0]["profile"] = "arbitrary"
    assert any("INVALID_READ_ONLY_PROFILE" in e for e in bridge.validate(job))

def test_bridge_rejects_actions_in_readonly_mode():
    bridge = load("worker_bridge_readonly_actions_test", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    job = base_job()
    job["actions"] = [{"type": "write_file", "path": "x.txt", "content": "x"}]
    assert "READ_ONLY_ACTIONS_PROHIBITED" in bridge.validate(job)

def test_audit_script_uses_canonical_readonly_connection_and_no_request_sql():
    text = (ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/sql_readonly_audit.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "readonly_sql_connection" in text
    assert "--profile" in text
    assert "sql" not in {"query_arg", "request_sql"}
    assert "INSERT " not in text.upper()
    assert "UPDATE " not in text.upper()
    assert "DELETE FROM " not in text.upper()
    assert "DROP " not in text.upper()
    assert "ALTER " not in text.upper()
